name: Monthly hosted field card discovery
description: 1st of the month 17:00: judge picker/jobs + stamp Orbit-hosted SDLC, Credit Risk, and Bayesian optimisation. Not stamp-only. Source-repo cards use their own discovery pass.

prompts.prompt:
AUTOMATION_CONTRACT

Before other steps: read `.state/AUTOMATION_CONTRACT.md`. Do not use ProjectBrain MCP.

Monthly discovery of Orbit-hosted field cards for Alex Touvras.

Repository: AlexTouvras/Orbit (branch main).
Follow docs/architecture/field-card-review.md section “Monthly hosted cards”.

Public cadence is monthly. Do not write “week of” or “Weekly review” on the cards. This is a discovery pass: judge picker and jobs, not a stamp-only bump.

Cards (Orbit paths, not source repos):
- public/sdlc-field-card/index.html — H1 “SDLC is a gate chain, not a phase poster”; spine BOUND → DESIGN → BUILD → VERIFY
- public/credit-risk-field-card/index.html — H1 “Credit risk is a lifetime, not a cutoff”; spine ORIGINATE → MONITOR → STAGE → PROVISION
- public/bayes-field-card/index.html — method card, not Hub; H1 “Bayesian optimisation is a budget of trials, not a search of space”; spine BOUND → MODEL → ACQ → STOP; read PLAYBOOK.md; not a BoTorch brochure

Steps:
1. Prefer open branch chore/monthly-field-cards-YYYY-MM for this calendar month; else create it from main.
2. For each card: confirm the spine, kill switch, Always-on strip, picker ≤7. Judge whether any picker row or job-table example should swap by constraint. Do not invent docs URLs.
3. If picker/jobs should change, edit the HTML. If not, leave picker/jobs as-is.
4. Always bump #version-stamp to Reviewed <this month> · Next: <next month>. Changed line: “Monthly review — picker and jobs unchanged” unless you actually changed HTML.
5. Do not edit the three source-repo cards (AI / analytics / delivery) except to keep inbound Bayes links if they already exist.
6. Do not add a Hub competency tile for Bayesian optimisation. Do not register FIELD_CARDS.
7. Commit/push to the monthly PR only. Write ## Summary with Decision: update|no-change per card (no-change still means you judged picker/jobs).
8. Stop. Do not merge. Do not Slack-Approve.

Done when hosted cards were judged and stamped for this month and the PR is open.
